title: Trading — Trade and Position View
description: Operational navigation from a campaign to a reconciliation. Grafana provides the path; the domain artifacts remain the truth.

list.name: domain_id
list.label: Domain identifier
list.description: An execution, position, exit, allocation or campaign id — NOT a trace id. Both levels exist and neither substitutes for the other.

options.content:
Enter a domain identifier above and this dashboard shows the traces and log lines that mention it. **The detailed truth is not here** — it is in the immutable artifact on disk, and the last hop leaves Grafana on purpose:

```
campaign  ->  trace  ->  execution  ->  position  ->  exit  ->  reconciliation
```

| You have | Artifact command |
|---|---|
| `trading.execution.id` | `execution explain --execution-id …` |
| `trading.position.id` | `exit explain --position-id …` · `positions explain` |
| `trading.exit.id` | `exit show --position-id …` |
| `trading.allocation.id` | `allocation explain --symbol …` |
| `trading.pnl.id` | `pnl show --position-id …` |
| `trading.reconciliation.id` | `reconciliation explain --reconciliation-id …` |

Telemetry stores **ids, never payloads**: no account number, no balance, no prompt, no model response, no order contents.

panels.title: Executions
panels.description: Every span carrying the identifier, whichever operation produced it.

panels.title: Log lines for this identifier
panels.description: Structured logs carry trace_id and span_id whenever they are emitted inside a span, so a line here leads back to its trace and a trace leads back to these lines.

panels.title: Lifecycle events
panels.description: The five named business operations Milestone 10 left as seams, plus settlement. Closure is broker reality: an exit that was submitted is not a position that closed.
